{{Quote|Keylander Station, the "Gateway to Makeb." I hear the souvenirs are pricey.|[[Nadia Grell]]|<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />}}
'''Keylander Station''' was the primary [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TOR updates|2.0}}</ref> the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] invaded the [[Makeb system/Legends|Makeb system]] and Makeb, [[Conquest of Makeb|conquering]] and occupying the planet. As a response, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic&mdash;[[Leontyne Saresh]]&mdash;summoned its heroes to Keylander Station to meet with her and the Republic's commanders to find a solution to the crisis.<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />
